concept: Volume and surface area of a cone
prompt:
A solid right cone has base radius 5 cm and height 12 cm.

**(a)** Find its volume. **[1]**

**(b)** Find its slant height and total surface area. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $V=\tfrac13\pi(5)^{2}(12)=100\pi\approx314\ \text{cm}^{3}$ **(A1)**

**(b)** $l=\sqrt{5^{2}+12^{2}}=13$ cm **(A1)**; $A=\pi rl+\pi r^{2}=65\pi+25\pi$ **(M1)** $=90\pi\approx283\ \text{cm}^{2}$ **(A1)**

**Common mistake:** using the vertical height $12$ instead of the slant height in $\pi rl$.

prompt:
An ornament is made from a solid right cone of radius 3 cm and height 10 cm, with a solid hemisphere of radius 3 cm on its base.

**(a)** Find the volume of the ornament. **[2]**

**(b)** Find its total outer surface area. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $\tfrac13\pi(9)(10)+\tfrac23\pi(27)=30\pi+18\pi$ **(M1)** $=48\pi\approx151\ \text{cm}^{3}$ **(A1)**

**(b)** Slant height $l=\sqrt{109}$ **(A1)**; curved cone $\pi(3)\sqrt{109}$ plus curved hemisphere $2\pi(3)^{2}$ **(M1)** $\approx155\ \text{cm}^{2}$ **(A1)**

The circular base faces are joined, so they are **not** part of the outer surface.

concept: Angle between a line and a plane
prompt: A cuboid $ABCDEFGH$ has base $ABCD$ with $AB=6$ cm, $BC=4$ cm, and height $CG=3$ cm. Find the angle between the diagonal $AG$ and the base $ABCD$.
markscheme:
The projection of $AG$ onto the base is $AC=\sqrt{6^{2}+4^{2}}=\sqrt{52}$ **(M1)(A1)**

$\tan\theta=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{52}}\Rightarrow\theta\approx22.6^{\circ}$ **(A1)**

The angle with a plane is measured to the line's projection on the plane, not to any line in it.
